Source contracts: scripts/update_gateway_runtime.py

scripts/update_gateway_runtime.py

Python · Tier B

Update and verify the active Gateway environment from canonical package metadata.

Usage

Run using the selected Gateway virtual environment; bare system Python is rejected.

Inputs

The active interpreter, authored prompt catalog and repository pyproject.toml; no credential or host inputs.

Side effects

Compiles the packaged prompt database before building runtime packages. Runs pip upgrade with full extras, pip check and a fresh runtime_readiness interpreter. Installs and verifies the required native fd dependency. Installs Chromium using this environment's Playwright and verifies a local headless render. On apt-based Linux, installs browser OS dependencies unless the existing system-dependency skip settings are enabled.

Cleanup

Exits nonzero on core/fd installation or readiness failure; reports optional failures. Never restarts services or rolls back package changes.

@see pyproject.toml

@see src/gateway_core/runtime_readiness.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
browser_install_command 39 Install the browser matched to this Gateway interpreter and honor installer skips.
native_constraints 51 Match GNOME's native ABI floor (https://pygobject.gnome.org/guide/sysdeps.html).
preserve_native_tool_paths 76 Keep macOS and Windows native clients reachable after installer PATH changes disappear.
optional_requirements 131 Expand canonical full extras without making them mandatory pip dependencies.
main 154 Require the core runtime and fd; report optional feature failures independently.
